intervention_description: Asset transfer program providing productive assets (primarily livestock) to ultra-poor households, with consumption support, skills training, and ongoing coaching

graduation_components_rationale.consumption_support: Weekly consumption support of 90 rupees/week for 30-40 weeks was provided
graduation_components_rationale.assets: Households chose productive assets like livestock or microenterprise inventory
graduation_components_rationale.skills_training: Implied by the comprehensive nature of the graduation approach
graduation_components_rationale.savings: Savings component was part of the program design
graduation_components_rationale.coaching: Ongoing support was part of the intervention
graduation_components_rationale.social_empowerment: No explicit social empowerment activities described

outcomes.outcome_description: Principal component index of livestock, productive assets, and durable household items (standard deviation units)
outcomes.literal_text: 0.2 SD higher at 18 months (p < 0.05), 0.4 SD higher at 3 years (p < 0.01), 0.8 SD higher at 7 years (p < 0.01)

outcomes.outcome_description: Monthly per capita consumption in 2018 US dollar PPP
outcomes.literal_text: 0.3 SD higher at 18 months and 3 years, growing to 0.7 SD higher at 7 years, remains 0.6 SD higher at 10 years (p < 0.01)

outcomes.outcome_description: Composite index measuring household food security (standard deviation units)
outcomes.literal_text: 0.2 SD more food secure at 18 months, 0.25 SD at 3 years (p < 0.01), grows to 0.4 SD at 7 years, remains 0.13 SD at 10 years (p < 0.05)

outcomes.outcome_description: Index of monthly loans and savings (standard deviation units)
outcomes.literal_text: 0.12 SD at year ten, statistically indistinguishable from zero

outcomes.outcome_description: Composite index of life satisfaction, sadness, and worry (standard deviation units)
outcomes.literal_text: 0.1 SD improvement at 18 months, growing to 0.25 SD by year seven, remaining at this level until year ten (p < 0.01)
0.285 SD (60 more minutes) at 18 months, 0.1 SD (21 more minutes) at 3 years, 0.15 SD (30 more minutes) at 7 and 10 years (p < 0.01)

outcomes.outcome_description: Monthly livestock revenue in 2018 US dollars
outcomes.literal_text: $10 higher at 18 months, $8 higher at 3 years, $27 higher at 7 years (p < 0.01)

outcomes.outcome_description: Monthly earnings from nonfarm microenterprises in 2018 US dollars
outcomes.literal_text: $25 higher at 3 years, $68 higher at 7 years (p < 0.01), 70% higher than control group

outcomes.outcome_description: Monthly wage income including remittances in 2018 US dollars
outcomes.literal_text: No difference at 18 months or 3 years, grows to $76-89 by year 7 (p < 0.01), remains high at year 10
